# Sacre Crown

> Sacre Crown ("Real Hair Solutions") is the hair brand of Sanofysi. It makes hair building fibres: fine black keratin fibres that are shaken onto thinning hair to make it look fuller and to sharpen a hairline in seconds. Sold online and delivered to every country in Africa and worldwide. The site is available in English, French (/fr/) and Swahili (/sw/).

## Key facts
- Brand: Sacre Crown (written SACRE CROWN on the pack). Parent company: Sanofysi (https://sanofysi.com).
- Tagline: Full hair instantly.
- Product 1: Hair Building Fibers, shade Black, net weight 27.5 g / 0.97 oz. Ingredients: keratin fibres, colorant. Price: $29 USD.
- Product 2: Hair Perfecting Kit: Hair Building Fibers + Hold Spray (118 mL / 4 fl oz) + spray applicator. Price: $29 USD.
- How to use: 1) start with dry, styled hair, 2) shake fibres over thinning areas, 3) pat gently to blend, 4) use the applicator for a sharp hairline, 5) lock in with Sacre Crown Hold Spray.
- What it does: covers bald patches in seconds, creates a fresh, natural hairline, looks like real hair.
- What it does not do: it is a cosmetic cover-up. It does not treat hair loss or regrow hair. It washes out with shampoo.
- Who it is for: men and women with black hair, including short, textured and afro hair (fades, low cuts, waves, natural hair).
- Delivery: every country in Africa (including Ghana, Nigeria and Kenya) and worldwide. Cost and time are shown before payment.
